headline: A Unified Interface for AI Coding Agents
lede: Fragmented AI workflows demand a central control plane. This proxy streamlines access to fifty different providers while optimizing token usage for high-performance development cycles.

headline: Bringing AI Reasoning Into The Terminal
lede: Stop context-switching between your editor and the web. This lightweight executable integrates ChatGPT capabilities directly into your shell for seamless automation and debugging.

headline: Automating the Full Job Search Lifecycle
lede: Finding your next role is now a multi-agent operation. From drafting targeted CVs to ranking job portals, this framework turns the application process into a systematic pipeline.

headline: Codifying Senior Engineering Principles for LLMs
lede: Stop your AI agents from over-complicating your codebase with unnecessary refactors. These strict configuration guidelines enforce surgical, goal-oriented code changes.

headline: The Self-Hosted Alternative to Jira
lede: Take back control over your product development lifecycle with a transparent, open-source project management platform. It offers the depth of industry-standard tools without the proprietary lock-in.

headline: An AI Assistant That Learns As You Grow
lede: Most AI interactions are ephemeral, but this agent builds long-term context through a persistent learning loop. It adapts to your specific workflows across Telegram, Discord, and local environments.

headline: The Official Community Marketplace for Claude
lede: A curated, verified registry for extending the functionality of AI coding assistants. Each contribution undergoes rigorous security screening to ensure seamless integration.

headline: A Local-First Alternative for Logitech Hardware
lede: Reclaim your peripherals with this Rust-based driver that eliminates telemetry and forced account logins. Manage your hardware settings with pure TOML configuration files.

headline: Local-First Workspace for Reproducible AI Agents
lede: Standardize your agentic workflows with an append-only log of every decision, tool call, and state transition. This approach enables absolute auditability and recovery in complex environments.

headline: The Unified Developer Platform for Product Insights
lede: Consolidate your analytics, feature flags, and error tracking into a single, cohesive stack. This platform scales with your needs, offering both managed cloud and self-hosted flexibility.
